newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to change coupons on high-yield post bonds.
newsitem.headline: Italy to change coupons on high-yield post bonds.

text.p: The Treasury said in a statement it has blocked a series of high-yielding Post Office bonds and would re-issue them with lower coupons.
Investors have poured into Post bonds recently as returns on better-known government bonds and bills dived.
The Treasury said the block on the old bonds came into effect on Monday. Only those bought before the government decree was signed would enjoy the old coupons.
It was still working out the new couponn, but an official said they might come down by up to 1.5 percentage points. Some longer-dated Post bonds had coupons of over 10 percent.
